ITEM 1 | About 15 smooth-skinned, oval berry-like pieces, about 2–2.5 cm long, in deep red, dark maroon and rosy-red shades with slight color variation; glossy, moist-looking skin, firm and whole, not cut, no browning or cooking marks, loosely piled in the center and lower part of a white foam plate of about 17 cm diameter, covering roughly 45% of the plate | 85

ITEM 2 | About 3–4 smooth, oval berry-like pieces, about 2–2.5 cm long, in pale yellow-green with a slightly darker blush on one side; glossy, moist skin, firm and whole, uncut, no cooking marks, scattered among the red pieces near the center of the plate | 15
